purpose: Teach: ナンバーワン/しかるに/彷徨/踏み入れ/かなう/変人/親分/両足

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんはぼくのナンバーワンだよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad is my number one.
lines.style: Warm, intimate address. Slow, deliberate. Like speaking a small truth directly to him. Gentle smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さんが「しかるに」と古風な表現を使われたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad used such an old-fashioned word — 'shikaru ni.'
lines.style: Quiet observation, slightly uncertain. Turning the word over in his mind. Not complaining — just noticing and checking if Mom heard it too.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが森を彷徨ったお話して下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, Dad says he'll tell us a story about wandering through the forest.
lines.style: Gentle relay of news. Warm attention — she's watching Sho's face to see if this interests him. Slightly sing-song, the way mothers tell kids about coming treats.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんの書斎に踏み入れる時はノックするよ
lines.en: Mom, I knock before I go into Dad's study.
lines.style: Small pride in his own respect. Serious tone — this is a rule he takes seriously. Brief and certain, not seeking approval but stating a fact he's proud of.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんの願いがかなうように祈ってるわ
lines.en: Sho, I'm praying that your father's wish comes true.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. Not performative — a private prayer said aloud to him. Slight pause before 'wish' like she's holding something precious.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんはちょっと変人だけど大好きだよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad's a little weird, but I love him so much.
lines.style: Open-hearted admission. Small laugh on 'weird' — affectionate, not mocking. Voice brightens on 'love' like the word itself is warm.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんはご家族の親分のような存在ね
lines.en: Sho, your father is like the head of this family.
lines.style: Observational, reflective. Speaking almost to herself. Approving tone — 'head' carries respect, not hierarchy. Slight nod in the voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんに両足の長靴を履いてもらったよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad let me try on both his boots.
lines.style: Excited, eager memory. Light, quick pace. Pride that Dad trusted him with something. Trailing up slightly at the end like he's waiting for her to smile too.
